hot100.songId: If I Were A Carpenter...Leon Russell

dedupeText: tribal gathering marquee sky 1970s aesthetic marquee lights sky typography tribal tableau desaturated color surreal landscape the glowing sky text acts as a celestial canopy over the grounded human tableau the warm tones of the dry grass and wood fire contrast with the cool hazy blue of the sky the verticality of the spears and standing figures anchors the horizontal expanse of the landscape combine vintage landscape photography with celestial marquee typography using a desaturated 70s color grade

recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle, desaturated 1970s-style photograph of a diverse group in a dry, grassy field, featuring a large iron cauldron over a wood fire, with text rendered as glowing marquee light bulbs floating in the pale blue sky.
coreVisualRelationships: The glowing sky-text acts as a celestial canopy over the grounded human tableau.
The warm tones of the dry grass and wood fire contrast with the cool, hazy blue of the sky.
The verticality of the spears and standing figures anchors the horizontal expanse of the landscape.
coreInvariants: Typography must be constructed from individual glowing dots (light bulbs).
The color palette must maintain a faded, analog film quality with low contrast.
The horizon line must be positioned in the lower third to allow for sky-based typography.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A wide group of figures occupies the mid-ground, centered horizontally, scaled to appear as a cohesive community unit.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large black cauldron and wood fire in the lower left-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the glowing marquee text in the sky, moves down to the central figures, and settles on the texture of the dry grass in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open sky in the upper half serves as the canvas for the primary typography.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Luminous white-yellow for the marquee light bulbs.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights in the sky-text to create a surreal, dreamlike glow.
paletteRestrictions: No deep blacks; shadows should be lifted and slightly brown-toned

letterConstructionRules: Each letter is composed of a series of distinct, glowing circular points.
The points must have a soft outer glow or bloom effect.
Letters are arranged in a slight arc or perspective to follow the sky's depth.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Individual bulbs should vary slightly in intensity to mimic real electrical lights.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style marquee text to maintain the surreal 'sign in the sky' concept.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the underlying skeleton for the dot placement.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle 1970s film photograph of a group of people in tribal and safari attire gathered around a large cauldron and campfire in a dry, yellow-grass field under a hazy blue sky. The image should have a grainy, desaturated, vintage quality.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of all-caps text in the upper sky area. The text must be constructed entirely from glowing white light bulbs, creating a marquee effect with a soft atmospheric bloom.

verificationChecks: Is the text made of individual dots?
Is the color palette desaturated and vintage?
Is the horizon line low enough?
Does the text have a soft glow?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the tableau
mustRedesign: Solid font strokes into dot-based construction
Modern digital clarity into vintage film texture

mustAchieve: Convincing light-bulb glow in the sky

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'light bloom' consistency across all letters.
Ensure the grass texture looks dry and sun-bleached.
Verify the sky has a natural gradient from horizon to top.
Confirm the figures are integrated into the lighting of the scene.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [vintage landscape photography] with [celestial marquee typography] using a [desaturated 70s color grade].
